meta.name: CCNL per i lavoratori delle Banche di Credito Cooperativo, Casse Rurali ed Artigiane

notes.text: Salary model is conglobated (stipendio per Art. 112 replaces paga base + scala mobile + EDR + other components). Modelled as base_salary with fixed_allowances: [].
First period valid_from set to 2024-09-01 (first tranche date per Allegato A). Pre-tranche salaries belong to the previous CCNL and are not modelled.
Seniority (Art. 113): first scatto after 4 years (48 months), then every 36 months; maximum 8 scatti for the Aree Professionali and 12 for the Quadri Direttivi (Art. 101), via maximum_count_by_level.

Apprenticeship (Art. 30) modelled for destination levels 3AP1-3AP4: months 0-18 one level below the destination, then the destination level. The Art. 3 comma 3 derogation (higher destination level) is assumed to follow the same 18-month rule.

limitation.remediation: Confirm that the Art. 3 comma 3 derogation follows the 18-month rule.

notes.text: Hourly divisor 160 in both periods per Art. 114 (rounding down to the nearest multiple of 5): 37.5h x 52 / 12 = 162.5 → 160 (pre-July 2025); 37h x 52 / 12 = 160.33 → 160 (from July 2025, Art. 118).
Workers covered: approximately 36,000 (Federcasse / Banche di Credito Cooperativo, Casse Rurali ed Artigiane). Agreement signed 2024-07-09; valid until 2025-12-31 per Art. 9.
INPS rates from 2026-credito.json (same sector as bancari-abi). IRPEF 2026 brackets applied (L. 199/2025).

APPRENTICE SENIORITY: the CCNL text read for this ruleset does not state whether apprentices accrue the level seniority increments or an amount of their own, and no apprentice amount is modelled. The engine pays no increment during the apprenticeship (provisional); the run is affected when the apprentice has matured increments the level pays.

limitation.remediation: Source the CCNL clause on apprentice seniority and model it as seniority_increments.apprentice_amount (zero when apprentices accrue none), then remove this note.

notes.text: INPS RATES: the employer and worker INPS rates of the sector (credito) are totals no 2026 INPS or association table confirms: the only component split found is the INPS guide of 2012 and the 2026 totals come from a software house page that does not prove its year. The contributions of every run rest on them.

limitation.remediation: Source the credito rates of 2026 on an INPS or association table, mark the inps block of contribution/2026/credito.json derived, then remove this note.

notes.text: SCATTI: at most 8 for the 1st and 2nd level of the quadri direttivi and for the aree professionali, 7 for the 3rd and 4th level of the quadri (Art. 101, Art. 113). Staff in service on 31 December 1997 keep 12 scatti (9 for the 3rd and 4th level of the quadri) plus a further periodic increase: the engine applies the limits of later hires, so a run for that cohort past the 8th (7th) scatto needs the extra amounts as a fixed input.

location.section: Valore della produzione
location.quote: per contributo ordinario (0,36 %) ripartito tra datore di lavoro e lavoratore nella misura rispettivamente, di due terzi ed un terzo, calcolato sulla retribuzione imponibile ai fini previdenziali di tutti i lavoratori dipendenti con contratto a tempo indeterminato, compresi i dirigenti

provenance.transformation: 0.36% split two thirds to the employer (0.24%) and one third to the worker (0.12%), on the INPS taxable pay of every permanent worker.
provenance.note: PDF sha256 a29c19b47b45ea058a586f6094a9ad9557cd3bd606256d6576c6857f902f620b, read on 2026-10-10. Apprentices included: an apprenticeship is 'un contratto di lavoro a tempo indeterminato' (D.Lgs. 81/2015 art. 41 c. 1, Normattiva, read on 2026-10-10); fixed-term workers excluded. Only the ordinary contribution is modelled: the additional contribution due when the fund pays a benefit and the straordinario contribution of the employers that use the assegno straordinario are not.

source_document.title: Testo coordinato del Contratto Collettivo Nazionale di Lavoro per i Quadri Direttivi e per il personale delle Aree Professionali delle Banche di Credito Cooperativo Casse Rurali ed Artigiane del 9 luglio 2024

location.section: Art. 46 - Tredicesima mensilità
location.quote: Nel caso di inizio o cessazione del rapporto di lavoro nel corso dell'anno, la gratificazione spetta in misura proporzionale ai mesi di servizio prestati, considerando come mese intero la eventuale frazione residua.

provenance.transformation: Any fraction of a month counts as a whole month.

reviews.scope: Second review of the credito group: stipendio of the eleven levels in the three tranches, scatti, number of monthly payments, against the testo coordinato signed on 19 December 2024.
findings: The 33 stipendi match Allegato A (p. 149) except two 2026 values, one cent off: 3ª Area 1° livello 2742.35 corrected to 2742.34, 2ª Area 2° livello 2572.10 corrected to 2572.11.
13 monthly payments: verified (Art. 46, tredicesima; no further monthly payment in the text).
Scatti: amounts match Allegato A; at most 8 for the 1st and 2nd level of the quadri, not 12: the 12 apply only to staff in service on 31 December 1997 (Art. 101). Corrected; the 1997 cohort is noted.
The FABI URL of the text no longer serves the PDF; the same signed text is cited from its Eutekne reproduction.
Not reviewed here: the hourly pay of Art. 114 (90.66% of one twelfth of the annual pay, divided by 160) and the overtime rates, which stay derived.
